race.comment: SILENT ANSWER (10) is the main danger after a Sunshine Coast win two back and a sound fourth last time. Should be at her top now fourth up. DOINGITEASY (5) is knocking on the door and should also be at peak fitness now. Couldn't get the job done as favourite last time at Grafton but is drawn much kinder this time and should be right there when they quicken. WEDDING VOW (12) stuck on gamely into fourth when resuming at the Gold Coast and is already a track and trip winner here. Is sure to have come on from the run and can play a more significant role this time. TURF GAZETTE (16) brings good Toowoomba form and should be at his top now. Can't leave out.
